thread:
lena_sales: Urgent: Fastcorp POC stuck. Their on-prem ADFS + SCIM bulk import fails. They do a 8k user POST and either get HTTP 413 or sometimes 429. POC demo tomorrow. Can we offer a short-term path?

 tom_se: 413 usually means some proxy/edge is rejecting large body. 429 indicates rate limiting on retries. Do we know which side returns 413 (their edge vs our gateway)?

 priya_platform: Customer sent a HAR. It's a single large JSON payload to /scim/v2/Users. Their ADFS front proxy enforces max body and closes long-lived requests. Also their tooling uses SAML assertion exchange that may time out on long uploads.

 dan_security: If the service account is using SAML-backed session tokens, long requests risk assertion expiration. Recommended: use a client_credentials service principal for SCIM with longer TTL.

 lena_sales: They said they only have SAML SSO today. Ops asked whether we can issue a time-limited hosted provisioning key to bypass their proxy for the demo (jumpbox IP allowlist). Security approval needed.

 tom_se: For a stopgap we can: 1) issue a scoped hosted API key limited to SCIM write, TTL 72h, IP-restricted; 2) provide immediate chunking script and exponential backoff; 3) advise on Dedicated/Private sync options.

 priya_platform: Chunking example to send: break into 250-user files and POST sequentially with retry on 429/5xx. Also suggest they upload from their jumpbox inside their network to avoid ADFS edge truncation.

 gateway_bot: Log search for tenant fastcorp pulled. Summary: majority of 413 responses come from customer edge (ADFS proxy). A handful of 429s seen at our gateway during aggressive retries. Ticket created: INC-4722.

 dan_security: I approve a 72h provisioning key with IP allowlist to their bastion and auditing enabled. Mark it "scim-provisioning-temp". I'll attach approval to INC-4722.

 lena_sales: I'll relay the plan and collect the bastion IP. Can eng/infra also add a short doc on using our SCIM relay for Dedicated/private customers? They may need repeated imports after POC.

 priya_platform: Will send a one-pager: 1) run SCIM sync from inside VPC 2) use incremental deltas instead of full replaces 3) enable streaming ingest on proxy.

 tom_se: Follow-ups: issue key, share chunk script, 15:00 PST sync call if they still hit issues.

 lena_sales: Thanks. I'll update Fastcorp and confirm demo readiness after they test the chunked import. :thumbsup:
